paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s girls held Center Hill to seven points Tuesday in Booneville, winning 66–7 for their third straight victory. The Warriors improved to 5–1. It was their highest point total of the season and the second time they held an opponent under 20.

The Warriors had last held a team under 20 on Nov. 10, when they beat DeSoto Central 53–19. Their previous scoring high was 60 against Lake Cormorant in the opener. Tuesday’s 59-point margin was their widest of the season.

Pontotoc started this winning streak with a six-point victory over Louisville after falling 55–51 to Decatur. The Warriors then won at Tupelo 57–40. Center Hill entered Tuesday’s game after a 58–25 loss to Booneville on Monday and is now 3–4.
The Warriors return home to play Houston at 6 p.m. Tuesday, Dec. 1. Houston was 5–0 when the Booneville tournament game ended.
